purpose: Probes behind the step 2 version 2 design: 8-decimal arithmetic, SUMINPUTS on the live node, monotonic texts, and whether any coin can be trapped at the vault

inProcess.name: VERIFYOUT(@AMOUNT) under keepstate at 8 decimals (the doctrine trap form)
SUMINPUTS one atom off is refused
TRAP vault coin carrying junk state (ports 8, 10, 12 set to hostile values) is still withdrawable
inProcess.note: The vault reads only the spending transaction's state, never a coin's own stored state, so no stored state can lock a vault coin.

inProcess.name: TRAP native MINIMA sent to the vault is withdrawable (registration holding Winiwa dust governs 0x00)
inProcess.note: Any token that reaches the vault can leave: a registration for that token id is free to create.

inProcess.name: TRAP a registration coin stored WITHOUT port 12 cannot withdraw (refused; it cannot touch the vault)
inProcess.note: App rule: create a registration only with ports 0, 1, 2, 3 and 12 set. A malformed one is refused for withdrawals; its owner can still close it (next probe).

inProcess.name: TRAP a registration coin stored WITHOUT port 12 can still be CLOSED by its owner
inProcess.note: v2 puts CLOSE before the state pins, so the owner recovers the atom of a malformed registration (only ports 2 and 3 are needed).

inProcess.name: TRAP a registration coin holding 100 Winiwa by mistake: CLOSE returns all of it to the owner
inProcess.note: Whatever amount sits in a registration coin, its owner gets all of it back (STATE(11) must equal @AMOUNT).

liveSuminputs.note: runscript runs on an empty transaction, so the sum is 0: this proves the function exists and runs on 1.0.45.15, not its arithmetic (that is the in-process rows).

monotonicByConstruction.rule: Contract.getGlobal marks a script non-monotonic when it reads @BLOCK, @BLOCKMILLI or @COINAGE (src/org/minima/kissvm/Contract.java, 1.1.2.6); a monotonic transaction is script-checked once and never goes stale (TxPoWChecker.checkTxPoWScripts, NIOMessage).
monotonicByConstruction.measured: every input of every case in step2v2_covenant_branches.json reports monotonic=true (summary.everyInputMonotonic)

finding: Unchanged from v1: VERIFYOUT(@AMOUNT) under keepstate PASSES in-process at scale 36, so this method does not reproduce the doctrine's recorded on-chain failure; the v2 texts keep the pinned-port form (STATE(11) EQ @AMOUNT, then VERIFYOUT(... STATE(11) ...)).
